Q5286.reason: The pyruvate dehydrogenase complex oxidatively decarboxylates pyruvate to acetyl-CoA in mitochondria; LDH, not PDH, interconverts pyruvate and lactate.

Q5287.reason: Under the majority agency/Redline rule, felony murder does not apply when a victim justifiably kills a co-felon, so the defendant is not guilty of that death.

Q5289.reason: UCC 2-508 lets the seller cure a rejected nonconforming tender by seasonable notice and a conforming delivery before the November 1 deadline, so the October 25 rejection was improper.
